ensemble_method: Fixed before any seed was scored. Soft vote over the three INT8 models of seeds 1, 2, 3 (same tokenizer, so tokens align): type = argmax of the mean of the three softmax type distributions; tag = argmax of the mean of the three per-token softmax tag distributions, and the target span is decoded from those tags by the unchanged decode_first_span; value = the unchanged rule parser gidi.value_parser.parse_value. No weights, no tuning.
gate_rule: Fixed before any seed was scored; the rule of retrain-v2 (old = the deployed encoder models/gidi-finance-v1): (a) frozen-test type macro-F1 drop <= 0.01, (b) frozen-test target exact drop <= 0.02, (c) human-value-01 debt-only slice (n=13, encoder + unchanged parser) end-to-end exact >= 0.8. Reported for seed 1 (deployment convention), each seed, the three-seed mean and the ensemble; nothing is selected by it.
